task.title: Build one desktop hero HTML section for AkvaTonus
task.goal: Create exactly one desktop hero section as a ready HTML file for akvatonus.ru. This is section 01 only and it must be strong enough to become the baseline for the rest of the desktop redesign.
constraints: Build exactly one desktop section only.
Do not build mobile in this task.
Do not touch section 02 or anything below.
Do not redesign the whole page.
Produce a real HTML file in the project folder.
Do not work inside Mottor editor in this task; output is an HTML file.
Do not insert real photos; leave clean media placeholders only.
Primary CTA text must be exactly: Записаться на сеанс.
CTA must be clearly prepared for popup usage.
There is one real procedure video in 9x16 and 16x9 with the same content; do not duplicate it.
If video improves the hero, leave one placeholder only; if not, skip it.
Use AkvaTonus facts only; do not invent unsupported medical claims.
Do not clone aquaslim.ru visually; transfer structure, hierarchy, scan logic, trust logic, and sales packaging only.
Keep the section clean, calm, modern, premium, and realistic for HTML/Mottor compatibility.
allowed_facts: до -6 кг и -5 см за курс без изнурительных диет
first session discount exists on current AkvaTonus site
WhatsApp and Telegram already exist on current AkvaTonus site
expected_structure: optional lightweight secondary contact action only if composition benefits
compact trust strip or trust badges
optional one video placeholder only if it improves composition
task.file_naming: ASCII only, with timestamp, example: akvatonus-2026-04-04_hero-desktop-01.html

required_report: weakest remaining part of the hero
